subject: Stratos Integrations — early-commit override & onboarding fee waiver
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Stratos Integrations — early-commit override and onboarding waiver

Kim —

Quick summary: Stratos (Alex H., CTO) is pushing hard for a larger discount tied to an immediate 24-month commit and a VPC/on-prem package. They want a 40% service discount for the first 6 months plus a full onboarding fee waiver. In return they’ll sign 24 months and commit to a minimum run rate of ~6M ARR over the term (ramp). Their legal/procurement team wants an answer this week to keep momentum.

Economics quick take (rough):
- List price: $1.25M first-year ARR baseline (their projected usage)
- Ask: 40% first‑6mo discount + waive $75k onboarding
- If we accept: NPV impact on year-1 revenue ~ -$350k, but multi-year revenue and reference value likely positive.

I attached the latest SOW and the draft commercial terms (Stratos_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf). I recommend we escalate for VP/CFO signoff because this touches onboarding fees + an above-guideline discount. My recommended counter (if we want to close this quarter):
- 30% discount on consumption for first year (front-loaded to first 6 months at slightly higher rate),
- 50% onboarding fee credit ($37.5k),
- Require 60-day minimum notice for early termination with pro-rata clawback for credits,
- Signature contingent on SOC2 evidence and VPC deployment schedule.

Can you review and advise whether to route to Marissa for formal sign-off? I can draft a short exec memo with ARR impact and suggested legal redlines.

Thanks —
Rohan
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com

---
Attachment: Stratos_SOW_Draft_v3.pdf (SOW stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Stratos Integrations — early-commit override and onboarding waiver

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding Rohan's note and the SOW. TL;DR: Stratos wants an outsized short-term concession (40% + full onboarding waiver) in exchange for a 24‑month VPC commitment. High strategic value (strong integration partner in our mid-market vertical) but the ask materially exceeds our standard discount ceiling and eats into onboarding revenue.

My read and recommendation:
- Approve a one-time commercial exception limited to this deal only (no precedent language in the contract).
- Offer 30% consumption discount year-1 (phased: 40% effective in months 1–3, 20% months 4–6, then 0 thereafter) — this gives them the early ramp they want but protects our long term ASPs.
- Provide a 50% onboarding fee credit ($37.5k) conditional on successful milestone acceptance (two-week pilot + security checklist).
- Insist on a 12-month minimum irrevocable commitment to the contracted seat/throughput baseline with an early-termination clawback pro-rata on credits.
- Require SOC2 report and an on-prem/VPC checklist signed off by our infra team before onboarding credit is applied.

I prepared a short memo outlining revenue impact and proposed sign-off language (kp_discount_memo_20261116.pdf). If you approve, can we route to Legal for the termination/clawback wording and then get Marissa's sign-off so Rohan can finalize with procurement? This needs to land by EOD Tuesday to hit their procurement window.

-KP
Kimberly Park
Head of Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: kp_discount_memo_20261116.pdf (internal memo stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Stratos Integrations — early-commit override and onboarding waiver

Kim / Jonas — reviewed and okay to approve with the following stipulations:

1) Approve the commercial exception under the terms Kimberly proposed (30% blended in year 1 with the phased structure and 50% onboarding credit) on the condition that:
   - Legal drafts a clawback clause that requires repayment of onboarding credit if customer terminates within 12 months (pro-rata), and
   - Revenue recognition remains consistent; Finance to provide a simple schedule showing the ARR impact and the expected payback timeline.

2) Require Procurement to confirm SOC2 Type II report and for infra to sign off on the VPC deployment plan before onboarding credits are applied.

3) Any reference language to the exception must include a sentence: "This concession is a one-time commercial exception approved by Redwood senior finance and sales leadership and does not set precedent for future agreements."

I will sign-off on the final commercial memo once Legal provides the clawback/termination text and Finance confirms the deferred revenue treatment. Jonas — please ensure the sales comp plan is not impacted by any manual crediting outside of the standard compensation flow.

Marissa Cole
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Alex — thanks for the patience while we escalated internally. Good news: leadership has approved a one-time commercial exception with a couple of required conditions. Summary of committed terms we can move to contract:

- 30% blended discount in year 1 (phased: 40% months 1–3, 20% months 4–6), then net list in year 2+
- 50% onboarding fee credit ($37.5k) applied after successful completion of the pilot acceptance checklist and SOC2 verification
- 12-month minimum commitment with pro-rata clawback of onboarding credits on early termination
- Exception language will be included explicitly in the SOW: "one-time commercial exception approved by Redwood senior finance and sales leadership"

We are sending an updated SOW and a DocuSign link for signatures. Legal will include the clawback and termination language you requested and Finance will provide a short revenue impact addendum. You should see the DocuSign within the hour: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?doc=STRATOS-SIGN

If this matches your understanding, please confirm and we’ll route the final SOW to procurement for countersignature. Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
